Agent-filed (open-brain head session, 2026-08-25) from a finding reported by an rtech-infra session and re-checked here.

## Measured (RUNNING, 2026-08-25)

`~/Library/Logs/open-brain-local/autostart.err.log` repeats on every launch:

```
local-clone launcher ADJUSTED the server child's environment: 2 configured key(s) are NOT in the child allowlist and were dropped -- OPENBRAIN_DEVELOPMENT_ROOT, OPENBRAIN_TEMP_WORKSPACE. The server child will not see them. Add each to CHILD_ENV_KEYS in scripts/local-clone.ts if it is meant to reach the server, or remove it from the clone env file if it is not.
```

`rg -n 'OPENBRAIN_DEVELOPMENT_ROOT|OPENBRAIN_TEMP_WORKSPACE' scripts/local-clone.ts` -> no match. `CHILD_ENV_KEYS` is at `scripts/local-clone.ts:33`.

`autostart.out.log` also carries 2 occurrences of `preflight failed; not starting` (embedding preflight), from earlier launches; the current process is up.

The launcher announces the adjustment correctly (nothing-is-adjusted-silently). The open decision is the one it names: are these two keys meant to reach the server child, or should they leave the clone env file?

## Done means

- Either `CHILD_ENV_KEYS` carries both keys, or the clone env file no longer sets them, and the reason is in the commit message.
- A fresh launch writes no `ADJUSTED the server child's environment` line to `autostart.err.log`.
